'''Aine 19 (April 3)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] and his party battle [[Trollocs]] and [[Myrddraal]]. They decide to take refuge in [[Shadar Logoth]], but after an encounter with [[Mordeth]], they decide to flee. After narrowly escaping [[Mashadar]], they become separated.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]] meets with [[Tylee Khirgan]] and makes an agreement to ally with the [[Seanchan]] against the [[Shaido]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Faile]] retrieves the [[Oath Rod]] to deliver to [[Galina]].
